query:
SELECT id,
                user_id,
                provider_user_id,
                provider_tenant_id,
                provider_object_id,
                email,
                email_verified,
                refresh_token
         FROM oauth_accounts
         WHERE provider = ($1::text)::oauth_provider
           AND (
                user_id = $2
                OR provider_user_id = $3
                OR (
                    $4
                    AND provider_tenant_id = $5
                    AND provider_object_id = $6
                )
           )
         ORDER BY CASE
                    WHEN $4
                     AND provider_tenant_id = $5
                     AND provider_object_id = $6 THEN 0
                    WHEN provider_user_id = $3 THEN 1
                    WHEN user_id = $2 THEN 2
                    ELSE 3
                  END,
                  id
